question.text: Capital gain on REIT units (held > 12 months):

explanation.text: The Logic: REIT units treated similar to listed equity for LTCG/STCG post recent changes. The Trap: Partial exemptions are not the rule. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Review REIT distribution break-up — each component may be taxed differently.
